description: This file defines configuration types, default settings, and functions for resolving, validating, and loading configuration for a Playwright-based testing tool, including CLI and environment variable integrations.

classes.name: CLIOptions
classes.description: Type defining command-line options for configuring the Playwright tool.

classes.name: FullConfig
classes.description: Type representing the complete configuration object after merging defaults, CLI, environment, and file-based settings.

classes.name: ViewportSize
classes.description: Type for viewport dimensions with width and height.

methods.name: fileExistsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously checks if a given file exists and is a file.

methods.name: resolveConfig
methods.description: Merges default configuration with a given Config object to produce a FullConfig.

methods.name: resolveCLIConfig
methods.description: Resolves configuration from CLI options, environment variables, and config file, merging them into a FullConfig.

methods.name: validateConfig
methods.description: Validates the provided FullConfig, checking for file existence and platform-specific options.

methods.name: configFromCLIOptions
methods.description: Creates a Config object from CLI options.

methods.name: configFromEnv
methods.description: Creates a Config object from environment variables.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads configuration from a file, supporting JSON and INI formats.

methods.name: pickDefined
methods.description: Filters an object to include only properties that are not undefined.

methods.name: mergeConfig
methods.description: Merges a base FullConfig with overrides from a Config object.

methods.name: semicolonSeparatedList
methods.description: Splits a string by semicolons into a list of trimmed strings.

methods.name: commaSeparatedList
methods.description: Splits a string by commas into a list of trimmed strings.

methods.name: dotenvFileLoader
methods.description: Loads environment variables from a dotenv file.

methods.name: numberParser
methods.description: Parses a string into a number.

methods.name: resolutionParser
methods.description: Parses resolution strings like '800x600' or '800,600' into a ViewportSize object.

methods.name: headerParser
methods.description: Parses header strings into key-value pairs.

methods.name: enumParser
methods.description: Validates and parses a string against a list of allowed options.

methods.name: envToBoolean
methods.description: Converts environment variable string to boolean if possible.

methods.name: envToString
methods.description: Converts environment variable string to trimmed string if defined.
